_notes: Firepit Hour: a cottage edition of OverDrive's Gerry's Percentages. Hayes hosts (captain), O'Dog reacts (assistant captain, much to his chagrin).

Voice: Hayes drives and sets up, plain and direct ('gotta', 'I just can't see it'). O'Dog is blunt and loud, ex-player, 'I really don't', 'moot point', 'they don't deserve the benefit of the doubt', jabs Hayes's three-button undershirts and golf outfits.

Written for Eleven v3 text-to-dialogue. Rules: [bracketed tags] are delivery cues and are not spoken; put them at the start of the line or right before the phrase they shape, one or two per line max. Ellipses (...) are pauses/beats; v3 has no <break> tag. CAPITALS are emphasis, so only cap the one word that carries the line. Numbers stay spelled out; hard names are respelled phonetically (Dry-sightle, Eye-kel, Elliott).
Cue fields (hl, reveal, final) are for the app's take card, not for TTS. Reveal lines carry the beat: setup ... number.
2025 items are sealed until Audit Night. Do not let the app show these scripts before an item is audited.
Settings: stability 0.5 = Natural. Drop to 0.3 if a clip sounds flat, raise to 0.7 if tags cause hallucinated words. seed keeps delivery close across re-renders.
Optional `caption` per line = what the captions show (real names, digits); otherwise tts.py derives it from `text` (tags stripped, respellings undone, number words to digits).

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: [excited] All right. Here we go. The Firepit Hour. Live from the dock at Colpoy's Bay. I'm Hayes. That's O'Dog. Noodles has the night off.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [chuckles] He's not off, Hayesy. He wasn't INVITED. Four guys, one fire... and an envelope that's been sealed for a year.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: And it's Nick's birthday. Happy birthday, Nick. He's a year older. He's not any wiser. We'll get to that.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [chuckles] One year older, one envelope closer to a Fraud tag. Blow out the candles, buddy.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Cottage edition of Gerry's Percentages. One year ago these guys put takes on the record. Sealed. Tonight we open them. Every one ends a W or an L. No pushes. Zero.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: NO pushes. You said it, you own it. That's the whole show.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Marshal. Whenever you're ready. Open it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: All right. The 2024 envelope. Macklin Celebrini. Goals. Rookie year. San Jose.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Eighteen years old, on a team that was BRUTAL. That's a tough number to put your name on.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Justin. Nine.
lines.caption: Justin. 9.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [laughs] NINE? He's got the first overall pick on the fourth line. I really don't know what he watched.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick, fifteen. Jay, twenty-two.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: And Chris. Twenty-five.
lines.caption: And Chris. 25.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [thoughtful] Twenty-five, for a rookie on THAT roster. That's a man who actually watched the World Juniors.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Here's the number. Macklin Celebrini. Twenty-five goals. Twenty-five.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [excited] ON the number! Not close. Not in the neighbourhood. RIGHT on it. That's a scouting report, boys!

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris takes the W. Justin. Sixteen off. That's an L. Back after this.

items.title: Gerry's %: Canadian teams winning a round-2 series

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: First one out of the 2025 envelope. And it's a real Gerry's Percentages. Canadian teams. Second round. How many win a series in May.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [sarcastic] G, E, double R, Y. Somebody had to say it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick put a board on it. Zero teams, fifteen percent. One team, seventy-five. Two teams, twenty-five. Three, zero. He did the math.
lines.caption: Nick put a board on it. 0 teams, 15%. 1 team, 75%. 2 teams, 25%. 3, 0%. He did the math.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: That's a man who brought a spreadsheet to a campfire. I respect it... and I hate it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Fifteen. Seventy-five. Twenty-five. Zero. That's a hundred and fifteen percent. A hundred and fifteen.
lines.caption: 15. 75. 25. 0. That's 115%. 115.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [laughs] He gave it a hundred and fifteen percent, Hayesy. That's not a board, that's a motivational poster.
lines.caption: He gave it 115%, Hayesy. That's not a board, that's a motivational poster.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris said two. Leafs and Oilers. Justin said one or two. Fifty-fifty. Jay said three.
lines.caption: Chris said 2. Leafs and Oilers. Justin said 1 or 2. 50/50. Jay said 3.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [appalled] THREE! Jay had the Jets, the Leafs AND the Oilers all winning a round. In the same spring. Buddy.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The answer. One. Oilers beat Vegas. Leafs lost game seven to Florida. Jets lost to Dallas. One.
lines.caption: The answer. 1. Oilers beat Vegas. Leafs lost game 7 to Florida. Jets lost to Dallas. 1.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [sighs] Of COURSE the Leafs lost a game seven. Ninety-five percent of the time, possibly higher... that's how it ends.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick had seventy-five on one. Nick takes the W. Justin, fifty-fifty. Not a number. Everybody else, L.
lines.caption: Nick had 75% on 1. Nick takes the W. Justin, 50/50. Not a number. Everybody else, L.

items.title: Which of KC, BAL, CIN make the playoffs?

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Next one. Kansas City. Baltimore. Cincinnati. Which of them make the playoffs.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: In September that's a LAYUP. Mahomes and Lamar. You'd bet the cottage on it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick and Chris. Kansas City and Baltimore. Justin. Baltimore and Cincinnati.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: And Jay. Here's the quote. I'm gonna go spicy. None of the above.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [laughs] None of the above! He's not picking a team, Hayesy... he's picking a FIGHT.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The AFC field. Denver. New England. Jacksonville. Pittsburgh. Houston. Buffalo. The Chargers. That's seven.
lines.caption: The AFC field. Denver. New England. Jacksonville. Pittsburgh. Houston. Buffalo. The Chargers. That's 7.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [excited] NONE of them! No Chiefs, no Ravens, no Bengals! Jay went spicy... and the whole conference went with him!

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: That's the call of the year. Jay takes the W. Nick. Chris. Justin. All L.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Mitch Marner. Year one in Vegas. Points.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Out of Toronto, on a line with Eye-kel, NO pressure. Everybody in this room had him going nuts.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Jay, one oh one. Chris, one hundred. Nick, ninety-five. Justin, ninety-two.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Four guys, ALL of them over ninety. Not one of them under. That tells you something.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The actual. Eighty. Twenty-four goals. Fifty-six assists. Eighty-one games. Eighty.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Eighty. He didn't get WORSE, boys. He just stopped playing with Matthews. It's a moot point how good he is... the number was never gonna be a hundred.
lines.caption: 80. He didn't get WORSE, boys. He just stopped playing with Matthews. It's a moot point how good he is... the number was never gonna be 100.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Closest is Justin at ninety-two. Justin takes the W. Jay. Twenty-one off. Worst in the room. L.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Rocket Richard. Who leads the league in goals.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris and Justin, McDavid. Jay, Dry-sightle. Nick, MacKinnon.
lines.caption: Chris and Justin, McDavid. Jay, Draisaitl. Nick, MacKinnon.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [annoyed] Three guys on Edmonton. I said it ALL year, that team doesn't deserve the benefit of the doubt... and neither do their scorers.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The answer. MacKinnon. Fifty-three. McDavid, forty-eight. Dry-sightle, thirty-five.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Thirty-five for Leon. Jay picked the one guy who fell off a CLIFF. Nick picked the guy who never does.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick takes the W. The Oracle. Again. Chris, Justin, Jay. L.

items.title: Malkin is a first-ballot Hall of Famer

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: This one isn't closing tonight. Evgeni Malkin. First ballot Hall of Famer. Yes or no.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris, yes. Justin, yes. Nick. No.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [appalled] Nick said NO to Geno. Three Cups, a Hart, a Conn Smythe... and Nick's over here like, [thoughtful] I dunno, let's see the resume.
lines.caption: Nick said NO to Geno. 3 Cups, a Hart, a Conn Smythe... and Nick's over here like, I dunno, let's see the resume.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Small problem. He's still playing. One year extension. Next season.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [chuckles] So this stays open until he retires, PLUS three years. Nick, you're gonna be defending this at the fire in twenty-thirty.
lines.caption: So this stays open until he retires, PLUS 3 years. Nick, you're gonna be defending this at the fire in 2030.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: No W. No L. Carried over. Moving on.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Auston Matthews. Goals. This one's been in the envelope every year since 2021.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Twenty-one was the constellations year. Nobody wrote it down. THIS time, they wrote it down.
lines.caption: 2021 was the constellations year. Nobody wrote it down. THIS time, they wrote it down.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Justin and Nick, forty-eight. Jay, forty-two. Chris, forty.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Forty-eight, TWICE. Two guys independently landed on the same optimistic number. That's the cottage talking.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The actual. Twenty-seven. Sixty games. MCL. March. Twenty-seven.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [sighs] Twenty-seven. Look, the injury's the injury... but forty-eight was NEVER happening. If you're a Leaf fan, you gotta stop pricing in the sixty-goal guy.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris at forty is closest. Chris takes the W. Justin and Nick, twenty-one off. Both L. Jay, L.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Willy Nylander. Goals.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick, forty-six. Jay, forty-two. Chris, forty. Justin, thirty-eight.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [sarcastic] Nick's got him at forty-six. Nick's got EVERYBODY at forty-six. He priced this team like it was twenty twenty-two.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The actual. Thirty. Sixty-five games.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Thirty. And that's with the team around him falling apart. I'll say this for Willy... he showed up. The numbers didn't.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Justin at thirty-eight. Takes the W. Nick, sixteen off. L. Chris and Jay. L.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Same guy. Points.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Nick, ninety-four. Justin, ninety. Jay, eighty-seven. Chris, eighty.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Chris at eighty is the low man AGAIN. He's turning into the only guy at this fire who watches the games sober.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The actual. Seventy-nine.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [excited] ONE off! Chris said eighty, he got seventy-nine! Hayesy, Binnington called YOU a fraud... this guy's the real thing.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris takes the W. Nick, fifteen off. L. Justin and Jay. L.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Super Bowl sixty. Who wins it.
lines.caption: Super Bowl LX. Who wins it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris, Detroit. Justin, Green Bay. Jay, the Chargers. Nick, Baltimore.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Two NFC North teams, the Chargers, and Baltimore. Nobody in this room said Seattle. NOBODY said New England.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Seattle twenty-nine. New England thirteen.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [laughs] Four guys, four picks, ZERO right. Not a single one of you had either team in the game. That's a clean sweep of L's.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Everybody wears it. Four L's. Four-way tie for last. What a night.
lines.caption: Everybody wears it. Four L's. 4-way tie for last. What a night.

items.title: Too much smoke on a Robertson move

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Last one. Chris. September twenty-ninth. Eleven-oh-one in the morning. On the record. Here's the quote. Too much smoke on a Robertson move for there not to be fire. We were all a year too late.
lines.caption: Last one. Chris. September 29. 11:01 a.m. On the record. Here's the quote. Too much smoke on a Robertson move for there not to be fire. We were all a year too late.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Nick Robertson trade rumours. The most reliable smoke in hockey. It shows up every October... like the leaves.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Justin's reply. Nine minutes later. You have some insider news, Elliott?
lines.caption: Justin's reply. 9 minutes later. You have some insider news, Elliotte?

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [laughs] Friedman over here. Only Chris put his name on it... and I notice he didn't put a DATE on it.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Only Chris weighed in.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: July first. Robertson. Traded to Pittsburgh. For a twenty twenty-eight fourth.
lines.caption: July 1. Robertson. Traded to Pittsburgh. For a 2028 4th.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Ten months late, for a FOURTH. But there was no clock on it, Hayesy. You can't lose a take with no clock on it. Fire is fire.
lines.caption: 10 months late, for a FOURTH. But there was no clock on it, Hayesy. You can't lose a take with no clock on it. Fire is fire.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: Chris takes the W. Unless the Marshal wants to argue the calendar. Nobody else was in the room.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: That's the envelope. Every take on the record for 2025. Opened. Called. Stamped.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: Four guys, one Super Bowl, ZERO right. That's the headline. The rest is on the scorecard.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: The Fraud tag for 2025. Worst score in the room. Jay. One and seven.
lines.caption: The Fraud tag for 2025. Worst score in the room. Jay. 1 and 7.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [laughs] None of the above got him ONE W, and the other seven got him the stamp. That's the spiciest one and seven I've ever seen.
lines.caption: None of the above got him ONE W, and the other 7 got him the stamp. That's the spiciest 1 and 7 I've ever seen.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: New envelope opens tonight. Whatever goes on the drum now, we read it back next September. That's the deal.

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: And Hayesy... lose the three-button undershirt before the golf tomorrow. For ALL of us.

lines.speaker: hayes
lines.text: [excited] For O'Dog, I'm Hayes. This has been the Firepit Hour. We're back next year at...

lines.speaker: odog
lines.text: [excited] Four p.m.! We'll chat then.
